sim_label: concept · reduced-order lap model · calibrated to 2026 pole laps · concept aero map v1 · sim v0 (game lap model, relative to the baseline concept car)

trained.doe: Latin hypercubes, seeded: 2400 over centre ± 100 % of the box, 1800 over centre ± 50 % of the box, 1800 over centre ± 20 % of the box

raw.source: physical() of 3000 uniform random concept designs over the part domains (concept/parts.js) + MARGIN

centre_car.label: concept · PhysicalCar v1 · design deltas (part-mass and concept aero map estimates) on the physics sim's estimated car

anchor.label: baseline 2026 car (prior + parameters estimated from the 2026 British GP pole lap)

error_vs_distance.definition: distance = max over RAW fields of |x − centre| / (box half-width on that side); test split, chosen models

ranking.definition: 40 parents (random walks from the concept baseline) × 8 children (design.mutate σ 0.08); Δlap = child − parent; designs through physical()

machine.note: wall-clock numbers of the training machine; not deterministic
